Before you visit.

USEFUL TO KNOW
01When can I visit?+

We are open from 12 noon to 11 pm. The dhaba is closed on the last Monday of every month. For special-day changes, please call our team before visiting.

02Where will I find the original Kesar Da Dhaba?+

You’ll find us at Chowk Passian, Gali Rajpura, near Telephone Exchange, in Amritsar’s old city. Get directions on Google Maps to plan your route.

03Does Kesar Da Dhaba have other branches?+

No. Kesar Da Dhaba has no other branches. Visit the original restaurant in Chowk Passian, Amritsar, for the Kesar experience.

04Who can I speak to about a group visit?+

Please call 0183 253 2227 to discuss your group visit directly with the team. They can help with current availability and your plans.

05Can I browse the menu before I arrive?+

Of course. Explore our complete menu for Punjabi favourites, thalis, pranthas and traditional sweets. You can also download the menu PDF from that page.

06Can I take a little Kesar home?+

Our house-special Punjabi Achaar and Mukhwas are available through the Kesar shop. Contact our team on WhatsApp for current availability and ordering details.
